title: A refusal reason stated in ordinary prose has a checked reader, or is marked unbound
why: Lane cost-line-has-reader (session_013NEJKzSDXuw4rJESuzdw1Y) found that refusal reasons written in prose (docs, records) have no checked reader, so they drift from the code that refuses; #2152 names this step on its Fix line (coordinator 09:47 CST Nov 8).
note: Filed 10:46 CST Nov 8 from that lane. Open: whether a machine can bind a prose refusal reason to its code; if not, #2152 turns its line into Fix: none with Until 2026-11-21. Related: cost-line-has-reader (rule verification-checked-reader-for-numbers). Coordinator 10:46 CST Nov 8: the lane probes whether a check can bind a refusal reason to its code; if so a follow-up with Merge after: #2152, else Fix: none with a reason, Until: 2026-11-21. Fix: none — a check could tie a verdict sentence to its code only if the record names its test; 417 verdict sentences in decision records, 2 name a test, 108 records name none (lane, measured on 2686e8d61); a rule over 108 records gets scrolled past, and review reads these sentences against the code. Until: 2026-11-21. #2152 body carries it (lane 10:51 CST Nov 8).
